(2) She presents a large green bag of Lay's potato chips to the camera; the packaging features a large image of coriander leaves and a potato chip. (3) She tilts the opened bag toward the lens to reveal its contents, showing it is roughly 70% full of thin, golden-brown chips. (4) The woman brings the open bag to her nose and inhales deeply, showing a neutral expression. (5) She holds a single, typical-looking thin potato chip between her thumb and forefinger for the camera to see. (6) She bites into the chip, and her eyes widen in a look of exaggerated shock and surprise, covering her mouth with her hand. (7) She continues to talk enthusiastically, gesturing with her hands while still holding the chip bag on a wooden table. (8) A large green and yellow text box appears as an overlay while she gestures with the chip, eventually ending with a clear frame of her smiling.
